headline: Discovered 4 core contracts across Ethereum; pending verification on Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism.
short_headline: 4 Ethereum contracts catalogued; multi-chain verification pending

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search found 2 Pareto Credit contracts on Ethereum: Credit Vault FalconX USDC (0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d, proxy-pattern), and USP token (0x97cCC1C046d067ab945d3CF3CC6920D3b1E54c88, ERC-1967 transparent proxy with implementation at 0x7b70fca01ab3745e24303b56f72296614768c337). Unrelated Pareto Network token (0xea5f88e54d982cbb0c441cde4e79bc305e5b43bc) is distinct legacy project; not catalogued.

Fetched audit links page (https://docs.pareto.credit/developers/security/audits); lists 12 audit reports (dates Aug 2024–Mar 2026) from Sherlock, Code4rena, and X77 covering Credit Vaults and USP. Google Drive links prevent direct PDF fetch for address extraction.
Audit PDFs not directly fetchable (Google Drive access restricted). Scope labels in audit table mention 'Credit vaults' and 'USP'; specific contract addresses require direct PDF access.

GitHub organization pareto-credit located (https://github.com/pareto-credit) with public repos: USP (Solidity), pareto-governance (Solidity), docs, landing. USP repo describes ParetoDollar and ParetoDollarQueue contracts. No deployment artifacts (broadcast/, deployments/) directly visible in search results; repo access limited by search tool.

Multi-chain coverage incomplete. D1 search exhausted on Ethereum; Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism searches not performed due to search quota exhaustion (2 queries allocated; used for deployed-contracts discovery and GitHub). Block-explorer searches per chain (D1 per-chain enumeration) deferred.

No factory contracts identified in current search results. USP repo mentions 'ParetoDollarQueue' contract managing deposits/redeems to vaults; relationship to factory pattern unclear without code review.

Role taxonomy applied. Ethereum addresses catalogued as 'vault' (FalconX USDC) and 'token' (USP). Implementation contract 0x7b70fca01ab3745e24303b56f72296614768c337 classified 'proxy_implementation'. pareto-governance repo exists but governance token address not yet resolved.
All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to Etherscan fetches. Snippet-only sightings (e.g., GitHub repo names without verified deployment) omitted pending code fetch.

rationale.verdict: Discovery catalogued 4 core contracts on Ethereum (1 credit vault, 1 token, 1 proxy implementation, 1 governance repo) with full audit report metadata but incomplete on-chain address extraction (PDFs inaccessible) and zero coverage on Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism. Multi-chain search deferred due to quota exhaustion; next assessments should attempt per-chain block-explorer enumeration and direct GitHub deployment-artifact walks.

protocol_metadata.about: Pareto Credit is an on-chain fixed-income operating system for programmable institutional credit. It facilitates private credit transactions between institutional lenders and borrowers through Credit Vaults and a synthetic stablecoin (USP) backed by collateral. The protocol uses ERC-1967 transparent proxy patterns for contract upgradeability and integrates third-party vaults (e.g., ERC4626) for capital deployment.
